stem.text: The diagram represents a cell surface membrane of a metabolically active cell and the direction of movement of some molecules through the membrane.

stem.alt: Diagram of a cell surface membrane bilayer with membrane proteins and arrows at points numbered 1 to 4 showing direction of movement through the membrane

stem.text: Which row shows a process by which the molecules may be moving through the membrane at each of the points 1, 2, 3 and 4?

A.text: carbon dioxide by diffusion; water by osmosis; glucose by diffusion; sodium ions by active transport

B.text: fatty acids by diffusion; oxygen by diffusion; carbon dioxide by diffusion; water by osmosis

C.text: sodium ions by active transport; carbon dioxide by diffusion; water by osmosis; glucose by facilitated diffusion

D.text: water by osmosis; oxygen by diffusion; fatty acids by diffusion; glucose by active transport
